name: @platform/api-client
description: Server-side client for the Go backend services, generated from their OpenAPI documents.

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript ../../backend/services/files/api/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/files.ts && openapi-typescript ../../backend/services/identity/api/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/identity.ts && openapi-typescript ../../backend/services/itsm/api/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/itsm.ts && openapi-typescript ../../backend/services/system/api/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/system.ts && openapi-typescript ../../backend/services/audit/api/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/audit.ts
